title: CS 61A homework with embedded 61A Bot feedback
summary: Students complete individual Python homework and may request one-shot, contextual hints from 61A Bot through the course autograder. The GPT-4 assistant receives the problem, student code, error output, and prior hint history but is prompted to support planning and debugging without giving complete solutions.
